acceptanceCriteria: Cargo metadata and release documentation consistently identify v0.2.52 without rewriting historical v0.2.51 failure evidence.
Release instructions and checks require an annotated tag push, reject lightweight tags, and do not precreate a provider Release.
Strict release gates, hosted workflow, immutable public artifact checksums, SBOM/provenance, and staged adopter acceptance pass without source or workspace binary fallback.
The published binary is installed only after checksum verification and the current repository reports healthy inspect, status, doctor, and agent doctor.
Object-repository inheritance and the immutable failed v0.2.51 publication history are explicitly documented.
goal: Release v0.2.52 from the reviewed main commit, verify public artifacts and adopter acceptance using only immutable release artifacts, then install and bind the published runtime to this repository.
intent: Publish the next patch release through an immutable annotated tag and a reviewed hosted workflow, preserving the failed v0.2.51 lightweight-tag history and preventing the same release-process error.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A reviewed annotated tag is peeled to the reviewed source commit and the public Release is created only after every required gate passes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the annotated-tag fixture, strict release route, hosted release workflow, and public artifact checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A lightweight tag has no peeled identity and cannot trigger a valid publication.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the annotated-tag regression fixture and inspect the release workflow identity check.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A downloaded public artifact passes checksum-bound adopter acceptance in isolated roots without cargo build/run or workspace binary fallback.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public adopter and N-1 acceptance harnesses against the published v0.2.52 Release.
